Manifest.Name: Pumpkin Days Hybrid Plants
Manifest.Description: A whimsical Content Patcher Edition of Platoniccat's Pumpkin Days Hybrid Plants. Discover magical hybrid crops like Bellchee, Tomatelon, and Raspkins, plus enchanted fruit trees like Banapple and Ginger Dragon. Updated for SDV 1.6+, bug-free, rebalanced, and dependency-free! Original sprites & concept by Platoniccat (Macskasajt/Archangel). Created with permission. 🎃✨
